knowledge_gaps: Reproduction requires explicit window size, decay units, gate initialization, embedding scaling and dropout choices, normalization placement, and checkpoint selection. Interaction-index decay does not model elapsed time.

The proposed residual needs comparisons with last-item-only, uniform-history pooling, and frozen-zero-gate controls. Otherwise, gains cannot distinguish recency benefits from additional capacity, smoothing, or optimization effects.

Training-history pseudo-holdouts may already have been prediction targets during fitting. They can support sensitivity analysis, but independent predictive claims require a leakage-aware protocol without changing benchmark splits.

The report lacks a budgeted experiment plan covering all four categories, the 200-epoch environment default, diagnostics, and adaptive validation selection. The potential and difficulty ratings remain provisional.
